events.what: Ghomi and Spruck claim a full proof; gap found early 2020; published version (2022, J. Geom. Anal.) reduces the conjecture to a total-curvature inequality
events.credibility_reason: Full claim had a gap (record: 'found to have a gap in early 2020'); surviving result is a reduction to an unproven inequality.

events.what: Chen, Ghomi and Wang prove the conjecture in dimension 5
events.ai_basis: The AI tools Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT (OpenAI) were used in the preparation of this manuscript.

events.what: Chen, Ghomi and Wang give a unified proof for dimensions 3-9
events.credibility_reason: A secondary source notes reliance on a Ghomi-Spruck regularity lemma (Lemma 7.2) established only up to dimension 7, which bears on dimensions 8-9.

events.what: Isoperimetric inequality under an added curvature-pinching hypothesis
Small-volume case under an added lower Ricci bound

judgement.doubts: Dimensions 3-9 are a restriction of an all-dimension conjecture; dimensions >=10 remain open. Dimensions 8-9 may depend on a regularity lemma known only up to dimension 7. The record gives the AI disclosure only for 2609.11005; it attributes no mathematics to the AI, so ai_role none. Pith Review is not a verification.

outcome_prefix: Judged: status rests on Chen, Ghomi and Wang's arXiv:2609.20517 (17 Sep 2026), a unified proof for dimensions 3-9, which is a case of the all-dimension conjecture.

corrections.why: F1: the record's own outcome says the preprint proves the conjecture 'in dimensions 3 through 9'. The bullet asks about Cartan-Hadamard manifolds in general, so a range of dimensions is a case. Being unreviewed does not make it a claimed full resolution.
other: the dimension 3-9 paper covers everything in the dimension-5 paper, so it is the furthest event. The status now rests on it.
F9: the disclosure says only 'used in the preparation of this manuscript' and credits the AI with no mathematics. It is also attached to 2609.11005, not to the 3-9 paper the status rests on.
